definitions.explanation: A state of well-being and contentment.

examples.japanese: {幸|しあわ}せな⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧
{幸|しあわ}せ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{願|ねが}う→願う：02387_negau⟧。
{幸|しあわ}せ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}っています→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧{幸|しあわ}せ⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I'm happiest when I'm with my family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{幸|しあわ}せな⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Watching the children play energetically makes me feel happy.

examples.japanese: ⟦あなた→あなた：02565_anata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出会|であ}えて→出会う：02298_deau⟧{幸|しあわ}せ⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I'm fortunate to have met you.

examples.japanese: ⟦こんなに→こんなに：02812_konnani⟧⟦{素晴|すば}らしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}けて→就く：10123_tsuku⟧、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{幸|しあわ}せな⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's truly fortunate to have gotten such a wonderful job.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幸|しあわ}せ⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: There was a big earthquake, but it was a blessing that the whole family was safe.

notes:
{幸|しあわ}せ functions as both a noun (happiness) and a na-adjective (happy). A fundamental word for expressing well-being and contentment.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {幸|しあわ}せ⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a happy person)
- Adverbial: {幸|しあわ}せ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧ (to live happily)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{幸|しあわ}せ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: Best wishes! (said at weddings)
- {幸|しあわ}せ⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧: lucky person
- {幸|しあわ}せ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel happiness
- {幸|しあわ}せ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧: to wish someone happiness
- {幸|しあわ}せ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become happy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{幸福|こうふく}→幸福：02750_koufuku⟧: happiness (more formal, common in writing)
- ⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧: joy, delight at a particular event
- ⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧: glad, a reaction to something that happens, where {幸|しあわ}せ is a broader, lasting state
- ⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧: fortunately (adverb), good fortune (noun); same kanji, different reading

WRITING:
- {幸|しあわ}せ (standard)
- {仕合|しあわ}せ (archaic/literary)
- {倖|しあわ}せ (rare, stylistic)
